name: Forge Arena Sandbox
status: Reconnaissance complete; playable mod not yet implemented
goal: Offline rules-enforced sandbox using Forge with Arena board layout and animation presentation

referenceSource.note: Reference source is newer than the installed binary; match source and binary before patching

route.rules: Existing Forge engine and human-controller input/choice path
route.presentation: Isolated LibGDX frontend fork/patch, initially using existing Forge card renderer and theme-aware components
route.sandbox: Separate explicit scenario edits through Forge setup/developer facilities; normal play retains rules enforcement
route.assets: Inventory local Arena assets and record format/provenance before conversion; exact shader/animation parity remains unverified

board: Two player avatars and life totals
Stack, targets, mana and priority prompts
animations: Cast to stack and resolve to zone
sandbox: Set initial life, hand and battlefield
validation: Legal choices come from Forge controllers
Insufficient mana and invalid targets rejected
Combat damage and life totals follow engine events
UI selection remains correct during animations

boundaries: Keep existing Forge install, preferences and decks unchanged while prototyping
No changes to MTG Arena executable or services
No claim of 1:1 animation/material parity from appearance alone
No standalone visual mockup accepted as playable completion
